{{2022–23 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2022–23 Florida Gators men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Florida]] during the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by first-year head coach [[Todd Golden]], and played their home games at the [[O'Connell Center]] in [[Gainesville, Florida]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 16–15, 9–9 in SEC Play to finish in eighth place. As the No. 8 seed in the SEC tournament, they lost in the second round to [[2022–23 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Mississippi State]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they lost to [[2022–23 UCF Knights men's basketball team|UCF]] 67–49 in the first round.

== Previous season ==
The [[2021–22 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Gators]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 20–14, 9–9 in [[2021–22 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC Play]] to finish a five-way tie for fifth place. As the No. 9 seed in the [[2022 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]], they lost in the second round to [[2021–22 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2021–22 Iona Gaels men's basketball team|Iona]] in the first round before losing to [[2021–22 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]].

On March 13, 2022, head coach Mike White left the school to take the head coaching position at [[Georgia Bulldogs basketball|Georgia]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Georgia hires Mike White: Bulldogs poach next men's basketball coach from SEC rival Gators |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/georgia-hires-mike-white-bulldogs-poach-next-mens-basketball-coach-from-sec-rival-gators/ |access-date=2022-04-01 |website=CBSSports.com |date=March 13, 2022 |language=en}}</ref> On March 18, the school named [[San Francisco Dons men's basketball|San Francisco]] head coach [[Todd Golden]] the team's new head coach.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hall |first=Graham |title=Florida hires Todd Golden as men's basketball coach |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/sec/2022/03/18/florida-gators-todd-golden-san-francisco-new-basketball-coach/7098769001/ |access-date=2022-04-01 |website=USA TODAY |language=en-US}}</ref>
